ShortDescription.Value: Ambulance depots, AMPDS call codes, emergency doctors, emergency corridors and realistic on-scene care.

Publish.LongDescription:
Realistic EMS reworks how ambulances work, modelled on Vienna's emergency medical service.
**BETA:** Back up your saves. Please report bugs and issues on GitHub: https://github.com/BrickCraftLP/Realistic-EMS-CS2/issues - attach Logs/RealisticEMS.log (turn on "Debug logging" in the options first).
Features - Ambulance Depot: a station without beds that houses many ambulances. - Ambulances only take patients to hospitals with a free bed, and only take new calls once back at their depot. - Configurable hospital bed capacity. - Unit callsigns and AMPDS call codes (Einsatzcodes Wien) with live call status. - Emergency doctor cars (NEF) from hospitals (experimental). - On-scene care time; police and fire brigade are dispatched for matching codes. - Vehicles on scene park off the road: on the sidewalk, in parking lanes or at intersection corners. - Emergency driving: pushing vehicles ahead, lane changes, turning from any lane, clearing red lights, emergency corridors.
Every feature can be switched off in Options. German and English.
Publish.ChangeLog: 26.0.0b: first public beta. Emergency vehicles stay closer to the middle when passing next to oncoming traffic and no longer squeeze past oncoming trucks. Angled parking keeps the rear out of the driving lane and the nose on the pavement. A free parking spot is used before the sidewalk. Behind slower moving traffic, emergency vehicles overtake on the oncoming lane when it is free. Fire engines also overtake on the oncoming lane. Pedestrian streets: vehicles stop where they are on scene, no emergency driving aids there.
